ChatSessionDoc.title: ChatSessionDoc
ChatSessionDoc.description: Cloud-synced chat session with associated primary wake word and configuration.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this chat session.

localChatId.description: Local Room ChatSession ID mapped to this cloud document.

title.description: Display title of the chat conversation.

wakeWord.description: Primary wake word phrase associated with this chat session.

systemInstruction.description: System instruction prompt for the Gemini persona in this chat.

themeColorHex.description: Hex color string for the chat accent.

iconName.description: Icon identifier for the chat avatar.

isDefaultWakeChat.description: Whether this chat is the default fallback wake-word target.

isPersistent.description: Whether conversation messages persist across sessions.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

ChatMessageDoc.title: ChatMessageDoc
ChatMessageDoc.description: Cloud-synced conversation message belonging to a user's chat session.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this message.

localChatId.description: Local Room ChatSession ID this message belongs to.

localMessageId.description: Local Room ChatMessage ID mapped to this cloud document.

content.description: Transcribed spoken text or typed message content.

triggeredByWakeWord.description: Whether this message was initiated via wake word detection.

messageTimestamp.description: Client epoch millisecond timestamp of the message turn.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

WakeWordDoc.title: WakeWordDoc
WakeWordDoc.description: Cloud-synced custom wake word phrase and sensitivity configuration.

userId.description: Authenticated Google user UID owning this wake word.

localWakeWordId.description: Local Room WakeWord ID mapped to this cloud document.

chatId.description: Associated local chat ID (0 when not linked to a specific chat).

chatTitle.description: Title of the associated chat conversation.

isEnabled.description: Whether this wake word is active in the detection loop.

sensitivity.description: Wake word detection sensitivity threshold between 0.50 and 0.98.

metadata.description: Optional metadata or system role identifier.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PlayerPresenceDoc.title: PlayerPresenceDoc
PlayerPresenceDoc.description: Multiplayer presence and RPG progression status for the Infinite Adventure Engine.

odinUid.description: Authenticated user UID owning this presence document.

currentActiveChatTitle.description: Active chat title, or 'Offline' when offline or in Stealth Mode.

isOnline.description: Whether the player is actively online (always false when isStealthMode is true).

isStealthMode.description: Whether 'Always Offline' Stealth Mode privacy is active.

sessionStartedEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds when the current session started (0 when in Stealth Mode or offline).

lastHeartbeatEpochMs.description: Epoch milliseconds of the latest client heartbeat.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest presence update.

/users/{userId}/chats/{chatId}.description: Per-user synchronized chat sessions and primary wake word settings.

/users/{userId}/messages/{messageId}.description: Per-user synchronized chat messages and transcribed voice turns.

/users/{userId}/wake_words/{wakeWordId}.description: Per-user synchronized custom wake words and sensitivity settings.

/presence/{uid}.description: Multiplayer presence and RPG status documents for the Adventure Engine.
